about.title: Chino Hills Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the paperwork arrives before the grief has even settled. Families in Chino Hills know this too well. In 2025, the city logged 96 injury collisions and 131 people hurt, and two people lost their lives. Many of the reported incidents cluster along SR-71, Chino Hills Parkway, Peyton Drive and Carbon Canyon Road, with Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. showing the highest counts. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, kept separate from whatever the San Bernardino County District Attorney may pursue. Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children hold the first right to file, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks considerably when a public agency is involved. LawProactive does not practice law. We are a free service that introduces you to an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: What a Chino Hills Family Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Who is allowed to bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family has the right to file so the claim is not dismissed on a technicality.

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is much shorter when a city, county or state agency may share responsibility. Early guidance protects your options.

items.title: Losses that the law recognizes
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Nothing is promised, but each category deserves careful documentation.

items.question: Our family member was killed in a crash on Carbon Canyon Road. Does the criminal case have to finish first?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and runs on its own track, separate from any charges the San Bernardino County District Attorney may bring. The two-year civil deadline does not pause while a criminal case is pending, so waiting can cost you the right to file. An attorney can coordinate the timing without interfering with the prosecution.

items.question: My sibling died, but they had a spouse and kids. Can I still file?
items.answer: Under California law the spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to bring the claim. Siblings, parents and others generally have standing only if they were financially dependent on the person who died or qualify as heirs when no closer relatives exist. An attorney can review your specific family situation and explain where you stand.

items.question: How much does it cost to use LawProactive and then hire an attorney?
items.answer: Our connection service is free. The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, which means there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You are never obligated to move forward after the first conversation.
